notes.subject: his right hand and his holy arm have gotten him the victory
notes.rationale: Seheberu se re: tshepho e dirilwe ke seatla sa go ja le letshwargo — go dira phološo; mantšu a Sepedi a bolokile sebopego sa go dira.

notes.subject: שירו ... שיר
notes.rationale: Go boela ga modumo wa go opela (širu, šir) — pego ya mmetse e timetše ka Sepedi.

notes.subject: opelang
notes.rationale: Taollo ya go opela e bitša setšhaba ka moka.

translation: Sefela sa go tletša ka diphala. Opelang go Yahwe sefela se swa, ka gobane o dire dilo tša makatsa; tshepho ya go phološa e mo go seatla sa gagwe sa go ja le letshwargo la gagwe la bokgethwa.
